versions.changelog:
- Added Google Sheets functions
- No user-facing changes or file changes detected in this release.
- Version number incremented to 1.0.9.

- Renamed skill from "porteden-drive" to "google-drive-secure"
- Improved description for broader Google Drive file actions and clarified secure alternative positioning
- Added details about reading file content with `porteden drive content` and distinctions between text, binary, and Google Docs/Sheets/Slides
- Introduced new commands for creating files with inline content and copying files (including Google Docs/Sheets/Slides)
- Updated and expanded notes on usage, file content limits, copy semantics, and environment variables
- Removed the sample file `skill-card.md`

Initial release of porteden-drive—secure, feature-rich Google Drive management CLI.

- List, search, upload, create folders, rename, move, share, and manage permissions on Google Drive using CLI.
- Supports both browser-based and token-based authentication, with credentials stored securely.
- Uses provider-prefixed file IDs and allows advanced JSON/compact output for AI integrations.
- Includes granular filtering: by folder, MIME type, name, shared status, and date modified.
- Shares files with users, domains, or publicly; can manage permissions and view/download links.
- Offers robust environment variable support and system keyring integration for credential persistence.
